rdfs:label: hadActivity
rdfs:comment: The optional Activity that mediated a qualified PROV influence — used on prov:Derivation (the activity that did the deriving), prov:Delegation (the activity the delegation was for), prov:Start and prov:End.
notes: Not used on Usage, Generation, Communication or Invalidation — those name their activity with `prov:activity`. Domain `prov:Influence`, range `prov:Activity`.

examples.title: Derivation referencing the activity that produced it

history.note: Corrected which qualified influences use hadActivity; range now prov:Activity IRI; updated seeAlso.
